description: Lists the connected personal trainer's students with status, goal and start date. Optionally filter by part of the name, or by joined_within_days to answer "who joined this week?" (newest first). Each row has the phone (the guardian's for a dependent) and app_url of the profile. Use the returned student_id with get_student.

joined_within_days.description: Only students who started in the last N days (0 to 365), newest first.

status.description: "active" (default) or "all", which includes pending and inactive students.

name: list_students
title: List my students
